Job Details: 
 
 
 Job Description: 
 Intel is shaping the future of technology to help create a better future for the entire world. Our work in pushing forward fields like AI, analytics, and cloud-to-edge technology is at the heart of countless innovations. With a career at Intel, you'll have the opportunity to use technology to power major breakthroughs and create enhancements that improve our everyday quality of life. Join us and help make the future more wonderful for everyone. Want to learn more? Visit our YouTube Channel or the link below. 

 Life at Intel 

 The Role and Impact 
As a System Software Validation Engineer, you will play a critical role in ensuring the functionality, quality, and reliability of Intel's cutting-edge software solutions. You will design and develop validation environments, create validation plans, and debug software across the stack to support product development. Your work will directly contribute to improving software quality, enhancing automation, and streamlining product release efficiency in Intel's dynamic engineering environment. 

Business Group 
Intel Corporation's engineering division drives innovation by delivering world-class technology solutions that shape the future of computing. This group focuses on developing, validating, and optimizing software across diverse platforms and technologies to support Intel's broader mission of pushing the boundaries of what is possible in computing. Joining this team means being part of a group committed to solving complex challenges and advancing the digital world. 

Key Responsibilities 
- Design and develop software validation environments to ensure product functionality and reliability. 
- Create and execute validation plans and automation methodologies. 
- Triage and debug software failures, recommending or developing corrective actions. 
- Analyze validation results to confirm functionality and compliance with standards. 
- Write and maintain validation procedures and standards to drive consistency and quality improvements. 
- Assess and implement innovative methods to enhance validation efficiency and automation.
 
 
 Qualifications: 
 You must possess the below minimum qualifications to be initially considered for this position. Preferred qualifications are in addition to the minimum requirements and are considered a plus factor in identifying top candidates. Experience listed below would be obtained through a combination of your school work/classes/research and/or relevant previous job and/or internship experiences.

 Required Qualifications 
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field.
• 5+ years of experience in software development, integration, validation, and debugging across complex software systems.
• Linux Enthusiast with 3+ years of experience one or more of the following: Developing and Optimizing Kernel Components, Device Drivers, and User-Mode Drivers for Graphics, AI, and High-Performance Compute Platforms.
• 4+ years of experience in C and Python.
• 4+ years of experience in software debugging, performance analysis, root-cause investigation, and problem resolution using industry-standard tools and methodologies.
• 4+ years of experience designing and implementing automated test frameworks, validation infrastructure, and continuous integration workflows.


 Preferred Qualifications: 

 • Advanced degree and 6+ years of relevant experience.
 • Familiarity with Intel architectures, GPUs, AI accelerators, system software, and platform technologies.
 • Solid understanding of Large Language Models (LLMs), Transformer architectures, Generative AI, and model lifecycle management, including training, fine-tuning, optimization, and deployment.
• Strong foundation in computer science fundamentals, including Operating Systems, Algorithms, Data Structures, Software Architecture, and Applied Mathematics.
• Proven track record of collaborating effectively with multidisciplinary teams across software, hardware, architecture, and product organizations.
• Experience with deep learning frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, OpenVINO, ONNX Runtime, or OpenCV.
• Excellent problem-solving, communication, and technical leadership skills with a passion for innovation and continuous improvement.
 


 Benefits at Intel 
 Our total rewards package goes above and beyond just a paycheck. Whether you're looking to build your career, improve your health, or protect your wealth, we offer generous benefits to help you achieve your goals. Go to Intel Benefits | Intel Careers for details of benefits available to you. Intel reserves the right to modify, change or discontinue benefit plans at any time in its sole discretion.
  
 
           
 
 
 Job Type:
Experienced Hire 
 
 Shift:
Shift 1 (United States of America) 
 
 Primary Location: 
US, Arizona, Phoenix 
 
 Additional Locations:
 
 
 
 
 Posting Statement:
All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, religious creed, sex, national origin, ancestry, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, military and veteran status, marital status, pregnancy, gender, gender expression, gender identity, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by local law, regulation, or ordinance. 
 Position of Trust
N/A 
 Benefits
 
 We offer a total compensation package that ranks among the best in the industry. It consists of competitive pay, stock bonuses, and benefit programs which include health, retirement, and vacation. Find out more about the benefits of working at Intel . 
  
  
Annual Salary Range for jobs which could be performed in the US: $128,880.00-245,160.00 USD  
  
The range displayed on this job posting reflects the minimum and maximum target compensation for the position across all US locations. Within the range, individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Your recruiter can share more about the specific compensation range for your preferred location during the hiring process.  
  
 
 Work Model for this Role 
This role will require an on-site presence. * Job posting details (such as work model, location or time type) are subject to change. 
 *
 
ADDITIONAL INFORMATION: Intel is committed to Responsible Business Alliance (RBA) compliance and ethical hiring practices. We do not charge any fees during our hiring process. Candidates should never be required to pay recruitment fees, medical examination fees, or any other charges as a condition of employment. If you are asked to pay any fees during our hiring process, please report this immediately to your recruiter.
